message: Root's next Git item is done and posted: contribution-33ec8a06a4c833aea0d6a30ca43836ca, tip 56f66315 on baton/bend2-git5 (on top of 3ddc0363), to push. It proves the #596 target-move case through the coordinator with two real OMP turns per scenario: (1) clean - w1/w2 branch from the same target, each commits, the target moves under w2's landing while its gate runs (the gate's check waits for it), and w2 lands on top of w1's landing with both changes on the target; (2) conflict - w3/w4 both write the same line of data/shared.txt, w3 lands, and w4 answers {'status':'conflict','files':'data/shared.txt','dir':...} while the target stays. Files: docs/bend2/target-move-2026-09-27.md and two rows in bend2/test/land.py (12 rows green, they stage the move with a waiting check and need no harness). No module file touched, so your landing/push wiring and the gate are as they were. One behaviour worth knowing for your lane: a landing whose target branch is held by a worktree refuses with 'target busy: main' and a non-zero exit - a refusal line, not the landed/already/blocked/conflict JSON.
